claim: When syncing attribution guards across PT, orama, and AlphaClaw, fix PT on its single open guard PR first, then byte-copy only GUARD_SYNC manifest paths to the one open PR per downstream repo — never open fragmented one-file PRs and never run orama-to-PT sync until PT canonical merges, or stale orama copies overwrite PT improvements.
